description.zh: 频道创建时间，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: The channel creation time. You can query data from the last 30 days. The value is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
The channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned.

title.zh: 订阅端获取通信中发布端用户列表
title.en: Retrieve the list of publishing users during communication from the subscriber side

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于根据订阅端获取通信中发布端用户列表。例如：您可以获取订阅端和发布端用户详情信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to obtain the list of publishing users in a communication session based on the subscriber. For example, you can retrieve detailed information about both the subscriber and the publishing users.  

### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 requests per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may affect your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
